entry.label: Practice: Patterns of Strategy: model dependence, fit and timing
entry.description: Analyse a strategic relationship and test a proposed move against relative dependence and response time. An original introductory relationship exercise. It does not reproduce the book's pattern catalogue or claim that one numerical ratio captures strategic power.

key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.

practice_connections: Map the strategic relationship from both sides.
Generate two moves that change the relationship rather than merely state an ambition.
Specify the evidence that would change your strategic choice.
